effect.kaleidoscope_cookery.hinder.descr: Slows down anything you hit for a short time.
effect.kaleidoscope_cookery.instant_smel: Makes ores you mine drop already smelted.
effect.kaleidoscope_cookery.projectile_d: Makes arrows and other things shot at you miss, and teleports you a short way away. Each dodge uses up some of the effect.
effect.kaleidoscope_cookery.vitality.des: Makes defeated mobs leave a baby of the same mob behind. Once in a while, a zombie leaves a baby villager instead.
